name: Heatmap
description: Density heatmap of another vector layer's features, rendered on a canvas over the 2D map. Points are weighted directly; lines and polygons are sampled into points.
descriptionFull: A heatmap layer loads no data of its own. It acquires the features of an existing vector layer in the mission (variables.sourceLayer) and rasterizes them into a density heatmap on a canvas overlay. Points contribute directly; LineStrings are densified along their length (variables.lineSampleSpacingMeters); Polygons contribute their densified boundary plus an interior grid sample. All rasterization happens in the map's projected pixel space, so custom/polar CRSs are supported. Only features in or near the current viewport are drawn, and the canvas is redrawn on moveend/zoomend and whenever the source layer's time window changes. 2D map only.

supportedData.label: Features of another vector layer in the mission
supportedData.description: The heatmap has no URL. It acquires the GeoJSON of the layer named by variables.sourceLayer through that layer's own type (file, geodataset, source plugin...) and renders a weighted density surface from it.
supportedData.procurement: Configure any vector layer in the same mission and name it as the source.

components.name: Layer Name
components.description: A display name for the layer.

components.name: Initial Visibility
components.description: Whether the layer is on initially.

components.name: Source Layer
components.description: The name of the vector layer in this mission whose features are rendered as a heatmap. Required.

components.name: Weight Property
components.description: Optional numeric feature property used as each sample's intensity weight. When empty, every sample weighs 1. Options come from the source layer's features; a nested path can be typed.

components.name: Weight Min
components.description: Optional. Weights are clamped to this minimum and, together with Weight Max, normalized into 0..1.

components.name: Weight Max
components.description: Optional. Weights are clamped to this maximum and, together with Weight Min, normalized into 0..1.

components.name: Minimum Zoom
components.description: The lowest (smallest number) zoom level for which to show this layer.

components.name: Maximum Zoom
components.description: The highest (greatest number) zoom level for which to show this layer.

components.name: Initial Opacity
components.description: A value from 0 (transparent) to 1 (opaque) of the layer's initial opacity.

components.name: Radius
components.description: Kernel radius of each sample. Default 25.

components.name: Radius Units
components.description: 'px' keeps the radius constant on screen across zooms. 'm' sizes the radius in map meters using the CRS resolution at the current zoom.

components.name: Max Intensity
components.description: Accumulated weight that maps to the top of the gradient. Default 1 (or the max sample weight when a Weight Property is set).

components.name: Line Sample Spacing (m)
components.description: Spacing in meters between samples along LineStrings and Polygon boundaries (geodesic). Default 10.

components.name: Polygon Interior Samples
components.description: Approximate number of interior grid samples per polygon (in addition to its boundary). Default 64.

rows.subdescription: JSON of gradient stops (0..1) to CSS colors. Ex. {"0.4":"blue","0.65":"lime","1":"red"}

rows.name: Information
rows.subdescription: Assign tags to this layer so that they may be searched upon through the LayersTool. A category may be specified with the following pattern: 'category:tag'
A freeform markdown description of the layer. In the LayersTool, users may click the information icon beside the layer's name to view this information.
